name: flatten
description: The opposite of the recommendation, kept as a control. Where the recommendation cuts the categories that pay for being on the pitch, this doubles them. Those categories are the only ones whose output barely separates an elite player from a replacement player, so loading weight onto them is the only way a linear scoring system can narrow the gap between the top of the league and the waiver wire. The point of running it is to measure what that costs: it decides value by clearances, aerials, recoveries and passes, which is what currently makes holding midfielders and accumulating centre backs so strong.
